boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Richmond
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and convenience stops with publicly posted late hours; confirm seasonal changes before heading out.

cards.title: Dean’s Den
cards.subtitle: Tyler Haynes Commons · University of Richmond
cards.notes: Head to Tyler Haynes Commons after 8 p.m. on a class night; the university lists Dean’s Den through 1 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus late service option with the latest listed closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: University Dining lists Dean’s Den open 8 p.m.–1 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday during the regular academic year.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation — University of Richmond Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Regular academic-year hours: 8 p.m.–1 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; seasonal and break hours can differ.

cards.title: ETC
cards.subtitle: Heilman Dining Center lobby · University of Richmond
cards.notes: Use the Heilman Dining Center lobby convenience store for snacks or essentials when campus dining options have narrowed later in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience store with midnight service on several nights.
cards.evidence_claim: University Dining lists ETC open until midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday during the regular academic year.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation — University of Richmond Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Regular academic-year hours: until midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday; 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: The Cellar
cards.subtitle: Tyler Haynes Commons · University of Richmond
cards.notes: Plan a carryout or dine-in dinner in Tyler Haynes Commons; Friday and Saturday service is listed through midnight during fall and spring.
cards.short_summary: A campus dinner destination with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cellar’s University Dining page lists fall and spring hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Cellar — University of Richmond Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Fall and spring hours list 5 p.m.–midnight Friday and Saturday; hours are subject to change.

cards.title: 8:15 at Boatwright
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Memorial Library · University of Richmond
cards.notes: Pair an evening library visit with a food stop at the named Boatwright location; Monday–Thursday hours are listed until 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A library-based campus food stop open through late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: University Dining lists 8:15 at Boatwright open until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday during the regular academic year.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation — University of Richmond Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Regular academic-year hours: 7:30 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday; Sunday service ends at 10 p.m.

cards.title: FlavUR
cards.subtitle: University of Richmond campus
cards.notes: Use this campus retail stop before a late study session; its regular Monday–Thursday schedule is listed until 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A campus retail dining option with 10 p.m. weekday closing.
cards.evidence_claim: University Dining lists FlavUR open until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday during the regular academic year.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation — University of Richmond Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Regular academic-year hours: 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday; closed on weekends.

cards.title: Taco Bell on W Broad
cards.subtitle: 5811 W Broad St · Richmond, VA
cards.notes: If using a car, the official location page lists this drive-thru through 3 a.m. most nights and 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru location with the latest posted off-campus hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service at 5811 W Broad St until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 5811 W Broad St, Richmond
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 7210 W Broad
cards.subtitle: 7210 W Broad St · Richmond, VA
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru rather than expecting late dining-room access; the official page lists service through 3 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A W Broad drive-thru with a uniform 3 a.m. schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 7210 W Broad St drive-thru open until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 7210 W Broad St, Richmond
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 3 a.m. daily; the dining room is listed only until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 9420 W Broad
cards.subtitle: 9420 W Broad St · Richmond, VA
cards.notes: Keep this location for a late drive-thru order: posted hours run to midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A W Broad drive-thru with midnight-or-later service every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 9420 W Broad St drive-thru open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 9420 W Broad St, Richmond
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Staples Mill
cards.subtitle: 8991 Staples Mill Rd · Richmond, VA
cards.notes: For a late car-based pickup, use the drive-thru; the location page lists a 1 a.m. close every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A daily 1 a.m. drive-thru option on Staples Mill Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 8991 Staples Mill Rd drive-thru open until 1 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 8991 Staples Mill Rd, Richmond
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 1 a.m. daily; the dining room is listed only until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Patterson
cards.subtitle: 11240 Patterson Ave #11250 · Richmond, VA
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late order; the official Richmond location listing identifies this Patterson Avenue restaurant as open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Patterson Avenue drive-thru with a posted midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Richmond locations page lists the 11240 Patterson Ave location as open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Richmond, Virginia
cards.access_notes: The official locations page lists this location open until midnight; check the store page before departing for day-specific changes.

warnings: Campus dining hours vary during breaks and summer; verify the University Dining hours page on the day of a visit. Off-campus drive-thru hours may differ from dine-in hours.
